title: review.json — agent-written review input
description: What the agent writes and post/record validate. One checker reports every problem: error refuses; warning lets record proceed and is promoted by --strict/strict_input. Errors: schema_version other than 1, missing/non-string/degenerate body, non-boolean approved, non-array comments or non-object items, comment path missing/non-string/not in diff, line/start_line wrong type, side wrong type or not RIGHT/LEFT, missing body, non-string suggestion, brief outcome/site/approach/question shape or range failures, rigor/severity wrong type or unknown, non-boolean in-bounds, kb non-array/non-string, resolved/triage/sections shape and enums, confidence non-integer or outside 1-5, non-string security_summary, malformed or partial chunks, and malformed verification claims. Warnings: missing schema_version, missing comments, no line/start_line, anchor outside hunks, unknown fields, unset rigor, brief site outside hunks, fenced suggestion, malformed kb id, and unknown or unattested chunks. Unknown top-level keys are allowed by the schema but still warn.

schema_version.description: Agents stamp "1"; missing warns, any other value refuses.

body.description: Full review text, verdict marker first line. Missing, non-string, or degenerate text (<20 chars with no verdict marker, or a short placeholder) refuses.

approved.description: Binding ask; the CLI --bind/--request-changes flags win over this. A non-boolean refuses.

comments.description: Inline findings; one per anchor. Missing warns as an empty list; a non-array or non-object item refuses.

resolved.description: Finding sigs (full or unambiguous prefix) the run addresses. Bare claims only record history; addressed needs verification.json evidence. A non-array or non-string item refuses.

triage.description: Status claims with rationale. Unknown status refuses the run; unknown sig warns; rationale under 30 chars keeps the prior status. Shape and enum failures refuse.

sections.description: Severity tags for ### body sections; exact heading string, unmatched tags ignored. Shape and enum failures refuse.

confidence.description: Review-level certainty, integer 1-5; a non-integer or out-of-range value refuses.

security_summary.description: One-paragraph security read; a non-string value refuses.

chunks.description: Coverage attestation on chunked bundles: every manifest chunk name the synthesis covers. Missing warns; non-array/non-string entries and attested-but-partial coverage refuse.

path.description: Diff-relative path required; a path not in the fetched diff refuses.

line.description: NEW-side line; numeric strings anchor like integers. An absent line/start_line warns and moves the comment to the body; a present non-numeric line warns and keeps it; other types refuse.

start_line.description: Multi-line range start with the same tolerance as line: absent warns and moves, non-numeric warns and keeps, other types refuse.

side.description: Defaults to RIGHT; LEFT for deleted lines. Any other value refuses.

suggestion.description: A fenced suggestion warns and demotes to the body (a fence inside would break rendering); a non-string value refuses.

brief.description: Optional machine brief. Shape, type, required-field, and range failures refuse; a site outside every hunk, past a cap, or a short approach/question warns and drops only that part.

rigor.description: Evidence rung; absent warns (rigor-unset) and records as said with rigor_source default, unknown or non-string values refuse.

severity.description: Stored at write time; unknown or non-string values refuse.

in-bounds.description: Hyphenated in agent input; absent reads true, a non-boolean refuses.

kb.description: Cited knowledge-base rule ids; a non-array or non-string entry refuses, and a malformed id warns and drops.

brief.description: The machine form of the finding: affected sites, the required outcome, an optional approach, and open questions.

sites.description: Affected changed files with an optional reviewed line. Site shape/type/line failures refuse; a site outside every hunk or past the 10-site cap warns and drops.

outcome.description: One sentence naming what the fix must achieve — required, 10–500 characters; missing, non-string, or out-of-range refuses the review.

approach.description: Optional suggested approach, 10–1,000 characters; a non-string or out-of-range value refuses.

questions.description: Optional questions for the human, at most 10 of 10–300 characters each; non-array/non-string or an out-of-range or past-cap question refuses.

line.description: Reviewed line inside a hunk; absent means the whole file.
